# Stanford School of Medicine

> > Stanford School of Medicine offers MD, PA, and PhD programs with emphasis on research, clinical excellence, and community engagement.

Part of Stanford Medicine, the School of Medicine provides comprehensive medical education programs including the MD program with Scholarly Concentration, Master of Science in PA Studies, and doctoral programs in bioengineering, biosciences, and health policy. The institution is committed to advancing medical research and serving underserved populations globally.

- MD Program
- Master of Science in PA Studies

## Admissions & Programs

- [MD Admissions](https://med.stanford.edu/md-admissions.html): MD program admissions process and AMCAS application requirements
- [PA Studies Admission](https://med.stanford.edu/pa/admissions.html): PA Studies admission criteria including healthcare experience and GPA
- [PA Entrance Requirements](https://med.stanford.edu/pa/admissions/entrance-requirements.html): PA program entrance requirements including GRE, GPA, and clinical experience
- [PhD Programs](https://med.stanford.edu/education/phd-programs.html): Doctoral programs in bioengineering, biosciences, and health policy

## MD Program

- [Research & Scholarship](https://med.stanford.edu/md/student-research.html): MD student research opportunities including Scholarly Concentration Program
- [Student Affairs](https://med.stanford.edu/md/student-affairs/life.html): OMSA student support services, advising, and wellness at Edwards Building
- [Evaluation Completion Requirements](https://med.stanford.edu/md/mdhandbook/section-3-md-requirements-procedures/section-3-7-evaluation-completion-requirements.html): MD program evaluation requirements for clerkships and POM curriculum

## PA Studies Program

- [Clinical Clerkships](https://med.stanford.edu/pa/curriculum/clerkships.html): Clinical rotation requirements for PA Studies program in California
